key_derivation: BDNB millesime identifier, as the producer names it. The export was published on 2026-05-22; the millesime it describes is 2026-02-a.

discovery.note: The producer publishes a dated departmental export for the current millesime, and a SHA-256 for it in a sibling _metadata.yml. The national export (39 GB csv, 51 GB gpkg) is therefore not needed: no local slicing is involved, so nothing about this release depends on a procedure of ours.

companion_assets.purpose: normalised per-theme tables, used to audit the field policy against the producer's own column dictionary

note: The CSTB is the first producer in this repository to publish a SHA-256 for its own asset: both checksums above were verified conforming on 7 September 2026. The URL carries the millesime, so it is not an alias -- unlike DS-02, see BUG-05.
